using System;
using System.Security.Claims;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Moq;
using Volo.Abp.Security.Claims;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.AspNetCore.SignalR.Authentication;

public class AbpAuthenticationHubFilterTests
{
    private readonly Mock<IServiceProvider> _serviceProviderMock;
    private readonly Mock<ICurrentPrincipalAccessor> _currentPrincipalAccessorMock;
    private readonly Mock<IOptions<AbpClaimsPrincipalFactoryOptions>> _claimsOptionsMock;
    private readonly Mock<IOptions<AbpSignalROptions>> _signalROptionsMock;
    private readonly Mock<IAbpClaimsPrincipalFactory> _claimsFactoryMock;
    private readonly AbpAuthenticationHubFilter _filter;

    public AbpAuthenticationHubFilterTests()
    {
        _serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
        _currentPrincipalAccessorMock = new Mock<ICurrentPrincipalAccessor>();
        _claimsOptionsMock = new Mock<IOptions<AbpClaimsPrincipalFactoryOptions>>();
        _signalROptionsMock = new Mock<IOptions<AbpSignalROptions>>();
        _claimsFactoryMock = new Mock<IAbpClaimsPrincipalFactory>();

        SetupServiceProvider();

        _filter = new AbpAuthenticationHubFilter();
    }

    private void SetupServiceProvider()
    {
        _serviceProviderMock
            .Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<ICurrentPrincipalAccessor>())
            .Returns(_currentPrincipalAccessorMock.Object);

        _serviceProviderMock
            .Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<IOptions<AbpClaimsPrincipalFactoryOptions>>())
            .Returns(_claimsOptionsMock.Object);

        _serviceProviderMock
            .Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<IOptions<AbpSignalROptions>>())
            .Returns(_signalROptionsMock.Object);

        _serviceProviderMock
            .Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<IAbpClaimsPrincipalFactory>())
            .Returns(_claimsFactoryMock.Object);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async void HandleDynamicClaimsPrincipalAsync_ShouldCallGetRequiredService_ForAbpSignalROptions()
    {
        // Arrange
        var claimsPrincipal = new ClaimsPrincipal(new ClaimsIdentity(claims: new[] { new Claim("test", "test") }, isAuthenticated: true, "test"));
        var hubContext = new Mock<HubCallerContext>();
        hubContext.Setup(c => c.Items).Returns(new Dictionary<object, object?>());

        _claimsOptionsMock
            .Setup(o => o.Value)
            .Returns(new AbpClaimsPrincipalFactoryOptions { IsDynamicClaimsEnabled = true });

        _signalROptionsMock
            .Setup(o => o.Value)
            .Returns(new AbpSignalROptions { CheckDynamicClaimsInterval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5) });

        // Act
        await _filter.HandleDynamicClaimsPrincipalAsync(claimsPrincipal, _serviceProviderMock.Object, hubContext.Object, skipCheckDynamicClaimsInterval: true);

        // Assert
        _serviceProviderMock.Verify(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<IOptions<AbpSignalROptions>>(), Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async void HandleDynamicClaimsPrincipalAsync_SkipIntervalCheck_WhenSkipCheckDynamicClaimsIntervalIsTrue()
    {
        // Arrange
        var claimsPrincipal = new ClaimsPrincipal(new ClaimsIdentity(claims: new[] { new Claim("test", "test") }, isAuthenticated: true, "test"));
        var hubContext = new Mock<HubCallerContext>();
        hubContext.Setup(c => c.Items).Returns(new Dictionary<object, object?>());

        _claimsOptionsMock
            .Setup(o => o.Value)
            .Returns(new AbpClaimsPrincipalFactoryOptions { IsDynamicClaimsEnabled = true });

        _signalROptionsMock
            .Setup(o => o.Value)
            .Returns(new AbpSignalROptions { CheckDynamicClaimsInterval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5) });

        // Act
        await _filter.HandleDynamicClaimsPrincipalAsync(claimsPrincipal, _serviceProviderMock.Object, hubContext.Object, skipCheckDynamicClaimsInterval: true);

        // Assert - no abort called, proceeds to claims factory
        _claimsFactoryMock.Verify(f => f.CreateDynamicAsync(It.IsAny<ClaimsPrincipal>()), Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async void HandleDynamicClaimsPrincipalAsync_SkipWhenDynamicClaimsDisabled()
    {
        // Arrange
        var claimsPrincipal = new ClaimsPrincipal(new ClaimsIdentity(claims: new[] { new Claim("test", "test") }, isAuthenticated: true, "test"));
        var hubContext = new Mock<HubCallerContext>();

        _claimsOptionsMock
            .Setup(o => o.Value)
            .Returns(new AbpClaimsPrincipalFactoryOptions { IsDynamicClaimsEnabled = false });

        // Act
        await _filter.HandleDynamicClaimsPrincipalAsync(claimsPrincipal, _serviceProviderMock.Object, hubContext.Object, skipCheckDynamicClaimsInterval: true);

        // Assert - doesn't call SignalROptions or claims factory when dynamic claims disabled
        _serviceProviderMock.Verify(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<IOptions<AbpSignalROptions>>(), Times.Never);
        _claimsFactoryMock.Verify(f => f.CreateDynamicAsync(It.IsAny<ClaimsPrincipal>()), Times.Never);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async void HandleDynamicClaimsPrincipalAsync_AbortConnection_WhenDynamicClaimsNotAuthenticated()
    {
        // Arrange
        var claimsPrincipal = new ClaimsPrincipal(new ClaimsIdentity(claims: new[] { new Claim("test", "test") }, isAuthenticated: true, "test"));
        var hubContext = new Mock<HubCallerContext>();
        hubContext.Setup(c => c.Items).Returns(new Dictionary<object, object?>());

        _claimsOptionsMock
            .Setup(o => o.Value)
            .Returns(new AbpClaimsPrincipalFactoryOptions { IsDynamicClaimsEnabled = true });

        _signalROptionsMock
            .Setup(o => o.Value)
            .Returns(new AbpSignalROptions());

        var unauthenticatedPrincipal = new ClaimsPrincipal(new ClaimsIdentity(isAuthenticated: false));
        _claimsFactoryMock
            .Setup(f => f.CreateDynamicAsync(It.IsAny<ClaimsPrincipal>()))
            .ReturnsAsync(unauthenticatedPrincipal);

        // Act
        await _filter.HandleDynamicClaimsPrincipalAsync(claimsPrincipal, _serviceProviderMock.Object, hubContext.Object, skipCheckDynamicClaimsInterval: true);

        // Assert
        hubContext.Verify(c => c.Abort(), Times.Once);
    }
}

        return new HubInvocationContext(
            context: contextMock.Object,
            serviceProvider: _serviceProviderMock.Object,

        var contextMock = new Mock<HubCallerContext>();
        contextMock.Setup(c => c.Items).Returns(new Dictionary<object, object?>());

        return new HubLifetimeContext(
            context: contextMock.Object,
            serviceProvider: _serviceProviderMock.Object
        );
    }
